question: Which retirement system's general investment consultant RFP requires respondents to currently provide non-discretionary general investment advice to at least 5 public pension plans larger than $5 billion and at least 2 public plans over $20 billion?
acceptance: TMRS or the full system name is sufficient; repeating thresholds is optional.
candidate_answer: It is the **Texas Municipal Retirement System (TMRS)**. Its general investment consulting RFP lists those client thresholds under “Minimum Eligibility Requirements.” [Source: TMRS General Investment Consulting Services RFP, p. 8](TMRS__TMRS_RFP_General_Investment_Consulting_Services.pdf#page=8)
